name: yt-topic-radar

scripts.build:ext: bun build ui/standalone-entry.ts --target browser --conditions=browser --minify-syntax --define __RADAR_STANDALONE_BUILD__="true" --define __RADAR_PRO_ENABLED__="false" --define 'process.env.RADAR_STORE_PATH'='".local-radar-store.json"' --define 'process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY'='""' --outfile extension/digest.js && cp ui/digest.html ui/digest.css ui/favicon.ico extension/ && cp scripts/manifest.prod.json extension/manifest.json && cp scripts/background.prod.js extension/background.js && cp scripts/dnr-rules.json extension/rules.json && rm -f extension/tts-scan-utils.js
scripts.build:ext:dev: cp ui/digest.html ui/digest.js ui/digest.css ui/tts-scan-utils.js ui/favicon.ico extension/ && cp scripts/manifest.dev.json extension/manifest.json && cp scripts/background.dev.js extension/background.js && rm -f extension/rules.json

description: Subscribe to topics, not channels. It scans YouTube, drops clickbait and Shorts, reads the timed transcripts, and produces deep, type-aware summaries with clickable `[MM:SS]` timestamps.
